output.attribution_rationale: Randomized van-team transitions compared MATCH-AI site-selection guidance with conventional staff-led site selection while retaining existing screening and diagnostic procedures.

achieved_dates.note: Results establish August 2023–September 2024; the registry instead lists an actual September 1, 2023 start and estimated October 2024 primary completion.

conflict.note: Funding, sponsor affiliations and implementer authorship are disclosed in the entry, but the sources establish no vendor funding, employment, equity, patent or licence relationship.

output.summary: The sources support the trial's nonsignificant 7% adjusted intention-to-treat difference, reported screening totals and achieved dates. The 32% increase comes from a selected adherence-based analysis and does not establish a randomized intention-to-treat benefit.
